landing.heroTitle: AI that helps SMEs win public tenders.
landing.heroSub: Ofera monitors Romania's SEAP procurement feed, checks which tenders you can actually win, and drafts the offer with you — from first notice to submission.
landing.problemBody: Thousands of SEAP notices a week, dense legal paperwork in Romanian bureaucratese, and no in-house bid team. Most SMEs never apply — not because they're unqualified, but because the process eats weeks they don't have.
landing.solutionTitle: A copilot that does the grunt work.
landing.solutionBody: Ofera filters the feed to tenders matching your profile, scores each one with explicit reasons, and assembles technical offers and DUAE drafts from your company archive. You review and decide — the busywork is gone.
landing.howTitle: From notice to submission in four steps.
landing.step1Body: We watch the SEAP feed and surface tenders matched to your CAEN codes, capacity and history — ranked by AI match score.
landing.step2Body: Each tender gets a verdict with reasons: what you meet, what's missing, and what's uncertain. Uncertainty is flagged, never guessed.
landing.step3Body: Five specialist AI agents assemble your technical offer, financials and DUAE from the tender file and your archive. Every section is labeled by its author.
landing.step4Body: A kanban pipeline follows every bid from identified to submitted — deadlines, values and results in one view.
landing.agentsBody: Instead of one generic chatbot, Ofera runs a panel of expert agents over every tender. Each owns its part of the draft — and signs it.
landing.specRole: Reads the tender file and extracts every requirement.
landing.eligibilityRole: Maps requirements against your company profile.
landing.legalRole: Checks exclusion grounds and declaration wording.
landing.writerRole: Assembles the offer narrative and evidence annex.
landing.riskRole: Flags gaps, missing documents and price exposure.
landing.agentsNote: Every generated section is labeled with the agent that wrote it.
landing.principlesBody: Every score ships with its reasons. Every verdict shows its evidence. When the file is unclear, Ofera says so instead of guessing — the final call is always yours.
landing.principle1: Every score ships with its reasons — open any tender to see why.
landing.principle2: Uncertain means uncertain: the AI flags gaps instead of guessing.
landing.principle3: Nothing submits itself. You review every draft before it goes out.
landing.footerTag: AI copilot for Romanian public procurement.
landing.footerHackathon: Built for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon.
